title: Forms and Form Management (Formik / React Hook Form)
description: Master creating and managing forms efficiently in React using Formik and React Hook Form libraries for validation and state management.

lessons.title: Introduction to Forms in React
lessons.content: Forms collect user input. In React, forms are usually controlled components where input values are stored in state.

lessons.title: Building Controlled Forms Manually
Challenges with Manual Form Management
lessons.content: Managing validation, errors, and complex forms manually can be tedious and error-prone, leading to repetitive code.

lessons.title: Introduction to Formik
lessons.content: Formik is a popular library that simplifies form state management, validation, and handling submission.

lessons.title: Basic Formik Form Example
Introduction to React Hook Form
lessons.content: React Hook Form is a performant library that uses uncontrolled components and refs for easy form handling and validation.

lessons.title: Basic React Hook Form Example
Validation Techniques in Both Libraries
lessons.content: Formik uses a validate function or external libraries like Yup. React Hook Form supports schema-based validation and custom rules.

lessons.title: Handling Complex Forms and Nested Fields
lessons.content: Both Formik and React Hook Form support nested fields, dynamic inputs, and field arrays for advanced form scenarios.

lessons.title: Choosing Between Formik and React Hook Form
lessons.content: Formik offers a straightforward API and is widely adopted. React Hook Form is lightweight and performant, especially for large forms.
